integrity: All-length theorem proved by unordered-edge-label multiplicities, parity and an explicit Eulerian construction; standalone finite verification corroborates, but does not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for cyclic covers of all three-letter palindromes for any alphabet size q>=2. It does not determine linear-superstring lengths, longer-palindrome covers, or the total number of optimal words; older unlocated equivalences remain a novelty risk.
title: Optimal circular three-palindrome covers and their parity-rigid adjacency profiles
